text.body: devatādhyāyabrāhmaṇam prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ āgnirindraḥ prajāpatiḥ somo varuṇastvaṣṭāṅgirasaḥ pūṣā sarasvatīndrāgnī ॥ 1 ॥ iḍānidhanāni padanidhanānīkaraṇidhanānītyāgneyāni ॥ 2 ॥ sarvāṇi nidhanavantyaindrāṇyanyānyādiṣṭebhyaḥ ॥ 3 ॥ sarvāṇi svārāṇi prājāpatyāni ॥ 4 ॥ yathā vāmadevyam ॥ 5 ॥ ṛk sāmāni saumāni ॥ 6 ॥ yathauśanakāve ॥ 7 ॥ vāṅnidhanāni vāruṇāni ॥ 8 ॥ yathā yajñāyajñīyam ॥ 9 ॥ akṣarānusvarāṇi tvāṣṭrāṇi ॥ 10 yathā vāravantīyaṃ cābhīvartaśca ॥ 11 ॥ svaḥpṛṣṭhānyāṅgirasāni ॥ 12 ॥ svarṇidhanāni pauṣāṇi ॥ 13 ॥ kayā naścitra ā bhuvad āpavasva sahasriṇam iti vāṅnidhane sārasvate ॥ 14 ॥ ya ānayat parāvataḥ ityaindrāgne ॥ 15 ॥ sutaṃ rayiṣṭhāḥ saho rayiṣṭhā ityāgneyaindre ॥ 16 ॥ vasavo rudrā ādityā viśve devāḥ ॥ 17 ॥ vasūnāṃ svārāṇi rudrāṇāṃ nidhanavanti ādityānāmaiḍāni viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ vāṅnidhanāni ॥ 18 ॥ yathā bhūyastvena pradeśā vartanta ityantarāṇi ॥ 19 ॥ athāntaratarāṇi savāṇyāgneyāni sarvāṇyaindrāṇi sarvāṇi svārāṇi prājāpatyāni sāmānītyantaratarāṇi ॥ 20 ॥ athāntaratamāni sarvāṇi brāhmāṇi sāmānīti sarvāntaratamāni ॥ 21 ॥ athopaniṣat ॥ 22 ॥ ṛgvai mātā sāma pitā prajāpatiḥ svaraḥ ॥ 23 ॥ atha yānyṛkta ākhyāyante mātṛtastānyākhyāyante । atha yāni sāmata ākhyāyante pitṛtastānyākhyāyante । atha yāni svarata ākhyāyante prajāpatitastānyākhyāyante ॥ 24 ॥ sa vā eṣa udgītho bandhumān bandhumatyaḥ ॥ 25 ॥ iti vedārthaprakāśe devatādhyāye pañcame brāhmaṇe prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ॥ 1 ॥ dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ athātaśchandasāṃ varṇāḥ ॥ 1 ॥ śuklā gāyatryo rūpeṇa sāraṅgaṃ rūpamuṣṇihām । piśaṅgaṃ kakubhāṃ rūpaṃ kṛṣṇāmānuṣṭubhaṃ tataḥ ॥ rohitaṃ bṛhatīnāṃ tu nīlaṃ pāṅktaṃ tataḥ punaḥ । suvarṇaṃ triṣṭubhāṃ rūpaṃ gauraṃ jāgatamucyate ॥ 2 ॥ ato yānyanyāni cchandāṃsi śyāvaṃ teṣāṃ tataḥ punaḥ । nakulaṃ tvekapadānāṃ dvipadā babhrurucyate । sāraṅgaśuklakṛṣṇarūpāṇi ṛgyjuḥsāmabrāhmaṇānvitāni ॥ 3 ॥ ye yajñeṣu prayoktavyāsteṣāṃ daivatamucyate ॥ 4 ॥ virājaḥ pṛśnayo vidyāt ॥ 5 ॥ daivataṃ tata uttaram ॥ 6 ॥ agnergāyatryabhavatsayugvoṣṇihayā savitā saṃbabhūvānuṣṭubhā soma ukthairmahasvān bṛhaspaterbṛhatī vācamāvat ॥ 7 ॥ virāṇmitrāvaruṇayorabhiśrīrindrisya triṣṭubiha bhāgo ahnaḥ । viśvān devān jagatyāviveśa tena cakḷpta (pra?) ṛṣayo manuṣyāḥ ॥ 8 ॥ prājāpatyā aticchandaso vicchandaso vāyudevatāḥ । puruṣo dvipadānāṃ daivataṃ brāhmya ekapadāḥ smṛtāḥ ॥ 9 ॥ vāsavī paṅktiḥ ॥ 10 ॥ satulaṃ manyetaitaddevatyā evaiteṣu chandaḥsvṛco bhavantīti ॥ 11 ॥ chandasāmu haitaddaivatam ॥ 12 ॥ iti vedārthaprakāśe devatādhyāye pañcame brāhmaṇe dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ॥ 2 ॥ tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ athāto nirvacanam ॥ 1 ॥ gāyatrī gāyateḥ stutikarmaṇaḥ ॥ 2 ॥ gāyato mukhādudapataditi hi brāhmaṇam ॥ 3 ॥ uṣṇigutsrānāt srihyatervā kāntikarmaṇo'pi voṣṇīṣiṇītyaupamikam ॥ 4 ॥ kakup kakudarūpiṇītyaupamikam ॥ 5 ॥ kakup ca kubjaśca kukatervobjaterbā ॥ 6 ॥ anuṣṭubanustobhanāt ॥ 7 ॥ anvastauditi hi brāhmaṇam ॥ 8 ॥ pipīlikā pelatergatikarmaṇaḥ ॥ 9 ॥ pipīlikamadhyetyaupamikam ॥ 10 ॥ bṛhatī bṛhatervṛddhikarmaṇaḥ ॥ 11 ॥ virāḍviramaṇādvirājanādvirādhanādvā ॥ 12 ॥ paṅktiḥ pañcinī pañcapadā ॥ 13 ॥ triṣṭubh stobhatyuttarapadā ॥ 14 ॥ kā tu tritā syāttīrṇatamaṃ chando bhavatīti ॥ 15 ॥ trivṛdvajrastasya stobhinīvetyaupamikam ॥ 16 ॥ jagatī gatatamaṃ chando jajjagatirbhavati kṣipragatiḥ ॥ 17 ॥ jajjalākurvannasṛjateti hi brāhmaṇam ॥ 18 ॥ aticchandāśchaderarthe ॥ 19 ॥ chandāṃsi chandayatīti ॥ 20 ॥ nicṛt nipūrvāccṛteḥ bharaṇāt bhurigucyate ॥ 21 ॥ athāto gāyatramāgneyaṃ bhaktyā bhavati । devānāṃ varṣīṇāṃ vā parameṣṭhino vā prājāpatyasya sāma ॥ 22 ॥ sāvitrīgeyaṃ yatrāgītam ॥ 23 ॥ ṛṣīṇāṃ viṣayajño yaḥ sa śarirādvimucyate । atītya tamasaḥ pāraṃ svarge loke mahīyate ॥ sahasrayugaparyantamaharbrāhmaṃ yaducyate । nākasya pṛṣṭhe taṃ kālaṃ divi sūrya iva rocate ॥ tataḥ kṛtayugasyādau brahmabhūto mahāyaśāḥ । sarvajño dhṛtimānṛṣiḥ punarājāyate smaran ॥ iti ॥ smaranniti ॥ 24 ॥ iti vedārthaprakāśe devatādhyāye pañcame brāhmaṇe tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ॥ 3 ॥ caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ atha sāvitryaṅgāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ । śiro brahmā । lalāṭaṃ dyauḥ । candrādityau cakṣuṣī । mukhamagniḥ । jihvā sarasvatī । tvaṣṭā grīvā । vasavaśca bāhū । uro vāyuḥ । romāṇi pā (vā?) yavaḥ । pṛṣṭhamindraḥ । viṣṇurnābhiḥ । prajāpatirjadhanam । ūrū marutaḥ । vedāḥ pādau । smitaṃ vidyut । śvasitaṃ vāyuḥ । asthīni parvatāḥ । samudrā vāsāṃsi । nakṣatrāṇi alaṃkāraḥ ॥ 1 ॥ ya evaṃ veda ॥ 2 ॥ duṣṭatādurupayuktānnyūnādhikācca sarvasmāt svasti ॥ 3 ॥ svasti devaṛṣibhyaśca ॥ 4 ॥ brahma satyaṃ ca pātu māmiti । brahma satyaṃ ca pātu māmiti ॥ 5 ॥ iti vedārthaprakāśe devatādhyāye pañcame brāhmaṇe caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ॥ 3 ॥ ॥ devatādhyāyabrahmaṇa samāptam ॥
